mapper.select: SELECT * FROM diary WHERE user_UN = #{user_UN} ORDER BY diary_date DESC
SELECT * FROM diary WHERE user_UN = #{user_UN} AND diary_date = #{diary_date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (user_UN, diary_date, weather, temperature, today_goal, content, star_rating, image_url) VALUES (#{user_UN}, #{diary_date}, #{weather}, #{temperature}, #{today_goal}, #{content}, #{star_rating}, #{image_url}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weather = #{weather}, temperature = #{temperature}, today_goal = #{today_goal}, content = #{content}, star_rating = #{star_rating}, image_url = #{image_url}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(star_rating), 0) FROM diary WHERE user_UN = #{user_UN} AND diary_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
